vb_textbox.text: Start by focusing on bright colors and purple, 'group one.' Keep using group one until you notice your winnings start to decrease.  When that happens, switch to dark colors and pink, your 'group two,' and see if it improves your results.  The best strategy is to alternate between the two groups, paying attention to when the winnings from each group start to drop.  Experiment for a few rounds when you think a switch is needed, flexibility is key. Don't stay committed to one group for the entire game.
